text:
The fault is in **M2**. Its width is 2.892 µm, while M1's is 20.23 µm with the same L. That gives a 7:1 mirror ratio instead of the 1:1 the task requires. The simulated output (2.748 µA) is about 1/7 of the 20 µA target, which matches the ratio, so the 86% error follows from this. M2 is also the most sensitive element for the failing spec. The fix is to set M2's W to about 20.23 µm (same W/L as M1).

```json
{"ranking": ["M2", "M1", "vdd"], "fault": "M2 width corrupted to W=2.892 um (about 1/7 of M1's 20.23 um), giving a 7:1 mirror ratio instead of 1:1; output current is about 2.75 uA instead of 20 uA. Restore M2 W to about 20.23 um to match M1 (same L=1.727 um). vdd is unconnected but is not a plausible cause of the error."}
```
